note: HGI-1 command processor (hgi-takeover 2026-10-09): ot_hgi_cp_die = hbm-forks ot_hgi_cp (config path + v1.0 sequencer) + loader link stations + VM read client + per-unit dispatch credits. One block (no N / S split). Units without a record adapter yet (ux_*) and the legacy SM launch tree (c*), SU (t_su_*), barrier, router and legacy coll config buses are not driven by the HGI CP: they show as ties until hgi-adapters lands the unit adapters. Bench rtl/hbm_accel/generic/tb/tb_hgi_cp_die_seq.sv: all sequencer vectors through the die binding exact.
